latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the pdf skill.

- Enables reading, extracting text/tables, merging, splitting, rotating, watermarking, creating, and encrypting/decrypting PDF files.
- Supports image extraction and optical character recognition (OCR) for scanned PDFs.
- Provides usage examples for Python libraries (pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab) and command-line tools (qpdf, pdftotext, pdftk).
- Includes guidance for avoiding font issues with subscript/superscript in PDFs.
- Offers references to additional guides for advanced features and PDF form filling.
